title: Mobile web support

body_markdown:
Frigade Assistant now runs on mobile web. Users get a bottom sheet designed for a thumb instead of a desktop panel squeezed onto a phone, with answers from a separate mobile knowledge base the agent built by using your product at phone size.


Behind it is a second product agent, trained separately on the mobile version of your product, because most applications have a separate mobile layout (the sidebar becomes a hamburger menu, settings move behind an icon, and so on). Answers point at what is actually on a mobile user's screen.


The mobile assistant takes as little room as possible, drops to the bottom while a user goes to act on the answer, rises with the keyboard, and respects safe-area insets. None of it needs configuring. Mobile is in early access, so reach out to us if you'd like it enabled for your workspace.
